text: Standup thread: yesterday wrapped scorer; today plan to start fixtures.
Manager: can you take a look at the failing CI on PR #155?
Looking at PR #155 CI logs: notarization step failing on missing entitlements.
git checkout the entitlements branch, ran build-app.sh to repro the notarization failure.
Reply in standup: actually getting pulled into PR #155 triage, fixtures later.
Opened a Linear ticket to track the notarization regression.
Compared entitlements file vs the working notarized build. Spotted a stray comment that AMFI rejects.
Removed the comment, rebuilt, re-ran notarization — passed on first attempt.
Sent manager: PR #155 unblocked. Root cause was a comment in entitlements (AMFI parser is strict).
Back to fixtures. Wrote the JSONL parser with serde.
Designer pinged about the icon mocks — said it could wait until tomorrow.
Re-read serde derive docs to confirm how default values work for Optional fields.
Finished FixtureEvent struct with #[serde(default)] on optional fields. Wrote a duplicate-id rejection test.
Posted end-of-day: PR #155 fix shipped, fixtures still in progress, ETA tomorrow.
